parameters.query: SELECT source, empreinte FROM soins.journal_imports WHERE empreinte = ANY(string_to_array($1, '|'))

INSERT INTO soins.journal_imports (source, reference, patient_id, empreinte, statut, detail) SELECT x.source, x.reference, x.patient_id, x.empreinte, 'importe', x.detail FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(source text, reference text, patient_id text, empreinte text, detail text) ON CONFLICT (source, empreinte) DO NOTHING

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify($('Garder les nouveautés').all().map(i => ({ source: i.json.payload.source, reference: i.json.payload.source_ref + '#' + i.json.payload.chunk_index, patient_id: i.json.payload.patient_id ?? null, empreinte: i.json.payload.empreinte, detail: i.json.collection + ' / ' + i.json.payload.type }))) ] }}
